method: Does stronger AdamW weight decay improve generalization and the useful ensemble contribution of our proven ConvNeXt-Tiny representation?
notes: Historical S06 cohort, ImageNet weights, architecture/head, seed,224,flip,weightedCE,effective32,AdamW/LRs/raw-accuracy LR scheduling are preserved. Planned optimizer intervention: decay0.0001->0.05 on the original parameter groups (including norm/bias). Engineering amendment: guarded FP32 validation instead of historical AMP; this can change selection/scheduler trajectories, so this is not a pure causal weight-decay estimate. Seed/runtime alone do not reproduce the old trajectory. No test or automatic next training; FP32 validation; exact20 window.
